install: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.cache" "$HOME/.waterscape"; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; P='export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/antigravity/bin:$PATH"'; grep -qxF "$P" "$HOME/.bashrc" || printf '%s\n' "$P" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/antigravity/bin:$PATH"; (command -v gcc >/dev/null || command -v clang >/dev/null); for t in cmake ninja python3 xvfb-run pkg-config git; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null; done; pkg-config --exists openssl freetype2 libpng x11 xext; test -f /usr/include/openssl/ssl.h; test -f /usr/include/freetype2/ft2build.h; test -f /usr/include/X11/Xlib.h; test -f /usr/include/X11/extensions/XShm.h; (pkg-config --exists libbrotlidec || test -f third_party/brotli/include/brotli/decode.h); test -f /usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc; test -f /usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoColorEmoji.ttf; R="$(pwd -P)"; B=/tmp/arcr_env_smoke_build; if [ -f "$B/CMakeCache.txt" ] && ! grep -qF "CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:INTERNAL=$R" "$B/CMakeCache.txt"; then rm -rf "$B"; fi; [ -f "$B/build.ninja" ] || cmake -S "$R" -B "$B" -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; cmake --build "$B" --target arcr_js -j2; ln -sfn "$B/arcr_js" "$HOME/.local/bin/arcr_js"; "$B/arcr_js" --version >/dev/null; "$B/arcr_js" -e 'if (2 ** 10 !== 1024 || typeof Promise.withResolvers !== "function") throw new Error("smoke");'
